translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: LUK
book.title: LUK Luk ere basem Tuma Yenbo. Kiyi late tuma.

content: Eme Jisas erne Pailat eteri bitimik tuma namdem.
Kaunsil tame akei eme Jisas erne Pailat eterke panen yim.

Yim, eme erne tuma namden etep wom. Nema lam, gwote tame ere nemri tatame nogwape emne porere yaper newom. Ere Romri apeilake erne takis kel newote emne wotakem. Sene ere etep wobetem. An Juda etemri apeilake. An Krais, God eter ane wom tame.
Etep womke, Pailat ere Jisas erne etep wometem. Ne Juda etemri kom panen siten apeilake o berai? Ere awosein etep wom. Ye, neren ne etep woye. Etep wom.
Pailat ere God eteri ake yaku kerebetem tame etemri apeilakeken tatame nogwapeken emne etep wom. Gwote tame ere wule yaper beke wuri nen.

Etep womke, eme tuma me gwungwunen etep wom. Ere tatame emne tuma won tasmol wayem. Eri tuma eme etep metem, eme gavman etemken ei naite nenem. Ere Galili distrikke yin etek yaku tasen yin Judia distrikke yin sene gwotek yan wusoubetem. Etep wom.
Eme Jisas erne Herot eteri bitimik tuma namdem.
Pailat ere etep metem, ere emne etep wometem. Ete tame ere Galili tame o?

Eme kir ten etep wom. Ye. Pailat ere etep meten abom, Jisas ere apeilake Herot eter lakerebe yekwori tame, eke ere Herot eterke won yim, Herot ere erne tuma namdete. Ete yabel Herot eter ere Jerusalemke temenem.
Temenem, Herot ere Jisas erne lam, ere metekwasem. Kiyi ere Jisas eri nenbetemkap metem, ere erne late wom, Jisas ere rigrabe nenen late wom.
Etep tem, Herot ere erne tuma nogwape wometem, Jisas ere erne awosein beke wo.
Awosein beke wo, God eteri akek yaku kerebetem tame emri apeilake etem, Moses eri wule wusoubetem tame etem eme teten erne tuma kenake namdem.
Tuma namdem, Herotken eteri ei nai tameken eme erne workwoyeken resen erne tuma yaper wom. Eme tame oub yenbosubuwai peten Jisas erne warruwun erne won yim, ere Pailat erne sene yin lam.
Kiyi Herot ere Pailat eterken peiktame temenem, ete yabel epe nowu kerem.
Pailat ere Jisas erne me kwuran kwanete wom.
God eteri ake yaku kerebetem tame etemri apeilakeken Juda etemri apeilakeken tatameken etemne Pailat ere won yan wurisubuk tetyewom.

Ere emne etep wom. Kem ete tame erne panen ane late yawo. Kem etep woye. Ere tatame emne porere yaper newon, emne ei naite wom. An erne keremri bitimik tuma wometlawoiwo. Kem erne namdeye tuma yaper an beke wuri met.
Herot eter kir ere eri tuma yaper beke wuri met, ere erne won nemne sene late yawo. Kem met. Ete tame ere be wos yaper beke wuri nen, eke nema erne mane pen sate. E yaper.
Etepkap an erne pakuwou pen mesginin yite. Etep wom. (
Nabe nogwape Pasova a abetem yabelke Pailat ere ake yaperke temenem tame wuri won ere komke sene yibetem. E etemri wule, eme etep nenbetem.)
Pailat ere Jisas erne won yite wom, tatame nogwape eme noubke ten etep wom. Jisas erne pen sate. Barabas eterne won sene komke yite. Etep wom.
Kiyi Barabas ere nogwape tameken eme kom panen si tame etemken kom sagke ei nayim, ere tame wuri pen sam. Pen sam, eke eme erne ake yaperke won wurim.
Pailat ere emne etep sene wom. An Jisas erne sene won yite.
Eme awosein wom. Berai. Erne mek kwuran kwanete. Erne mek kwuran kwanete.

Etep womke, Pailat ere tewo mur won emne sene etep wometem. Gwote tame ere wule yaper beke wuri nen. An eri nenem wule yaper beke wuri la, nema erne mane pen sate. Etepkap an erne pakuwouke pen sene won yite.
Etep wom, eme noubke som tebetem. Erne mek kwuran kwanete. Emri taye Pailat eri tuma ragerkwunbetem.
Ragerkwunbetem, ere Jisas erne mek kwuran kwanete tuma kir tem.

Kir tem, ere tatame emri wom tame, Barabas, erne won sene komke yim. Ete tame ere kiyi kom panen si tame etemken ei nayim, ere tame wuri pen sam, eke eme erne ake yaperke won wurim. Pailat ere erne won sene yim, ere Jisas erne peten tatame emne newon etep wom. Kem keremri porerek erne nente. Etep wom.
Eme Jisas erne me kwuran kwanem.
Eme Jisas erne panen yibetem, eme lam, Sairini tame wuri, eri sig Saimon, ere yan kom sagke wurte yabetem. Wurte yabetem, eme erne keresukun me eme eteri gware luke rasem, Jisas erne semowum.
Semowum, tatame nogwape eme erne semowum, ta kau eme erne kera keraken semoumenem.
Semoumenem, Jisas ere emne petkwo lan emne etep wom. Jerusalemri ta, kem ane mane kerate. Kem kerem maime sogwoke kerate, keremri yen etemne kerate. Yuri tame eme emne yaper nente nenbe.
Metye. Yuri akeite yabel tete, tatame eme etep wote. Yen game a ta, yenken berai ta, yen muk beke newon a ta eme metekwaste. Etep wote. Akeite tatame emri yen eme mus mette, eke eme etep wote.

Ete yabel tatame eme mus eisau mette, eke eme sate abon kow eisau erne etep wote. Ne boken yeirin nemne ragerkerete. Eme kow nebule emne etepwou wote. Kem boken yeirin nemne ragerkerete. Etep wote nenbe.
An pap wayebe tame berai, an tame yenbo. Eme ane yaper nenbe. Yuri tame yaper eme kemne yaperwai nente nenbe. Jisas ere etep wom.
Eme akeite tame pes etepne kir panen yim. Epe sir petbetem tame. Eme epne Jisas eterken pen sate wom.

Won yim, eme kow nebulek yan yawom. Kow sig Tame Tare Bai. Kowke yawon eme erne mek kwuran kwanem. Kwanem, eme sir petbetem tame pes etepne etek kir kwanem. Wuri Jisas eteri let pi seit yekwok tetruwum, wuri let gwaime yekwok tetruwum.

Kwanem, Jisas ere etep wom. Apei, ne emri nenbetem wule yaper peten sepitte. Eme emri nenbe wule yaper beke abo. Etep wom, Romri ei nai tame eme etemwou etemwou satu sou tetem, eme eri tame oub wosam.

Tatame eme teten erne lakerebetem, Juda etemri apeilake eme Jisas erne tuma yaper etep workwoyeken resen etep wom. Kiyi ere akeite tatame etemne kobo labetem. Ere wom, ere God eter won yam tame. Eter seken wote, ere eter maime kobo late.
Etep wom, ei nai tame etem kir eme erne tuma yaper wobetem. Eme yan mekinke teten erne kwole yabe ok newom, eme erne etep wom.
Ne Juda etemri kom panen sibe apeilake, ne neren maime kobo late. Eme etep wom.
Basem tuma wuri eme eteri tare iye yekwok peikkerem. Eme etep basem. Gwote tame ere Juda tatame etemri kom panen siten apeilake. Eme etep basem.
Sir petbetem tame wuri ere Jisas erne tuma yaper etep wom. Ne wom, ne Krais, God eter wom tame. Etepkap ne neren maime kobo late, nesetne kir kobo late.
Etep womke, sir petbetem tame wuri ere erne wotaken etep wom. Eme nemne murke pen sate woye. Beke ne God erne beke ak?
Kiyi nesa wule yaper nenbetem, sene nesa mus metbe, e yenbo. Gwote tame ere wule yaper beke wuri nen, eke ere mus bepou metbe.
Ere Jisas erne etep wom. Jisas, yuri ne kom panen site, ne ane kir abote.
Jisas ere erne etep wom. An nene sekenke wobe. Gwotepte ne arenken kom yenbok tete.
Jisas ere sam.
Yabel komluke simenem, nowsel neirkap teketekeren yam, perpe tebetem, yabel ere sene pasem.
Yabel sene pasem, mate eisau, God eteri ake eisauke eismenem mate, ere etiya yekwok pekan yeirin kerare kerare tem.
Tem, Jisas ere noubke ten etep wom. Apei, ari wou an neri letke rasye. Etep won ere ek sam.
Sam, ei nai tame etemri apeilake ere ete wos lam, ere God eri sig eisau wom. Ere etep wom. Ete tame ere tame yenbo sekenwai.
Etep wom, tatame nogwape eme etek erne late yan wurisubuk tetmenem, eme lam, ere sam. Etep lam, eme pap yaper ten eme sene yikwutem.
Yikwutem, Jisas eri nowuken Galilike erne semowun yam taken eme yan gene kerak teten eme ete wos kir lam.
Eme Jisas eri kupa peten pape purik rasem.

Tame wuri eri sig Josep, ere Arimatea komri tame. Ere tame yenbowai, ere abom, God ere kom panen site, ere etep koumenem. Ere kaunsil tame etemri wuri, kiyi kaunsil eme Jisas erne pen sate wom, ere kir beke te.
Kir beke te, ere Pailat erne yin lan Jisas eri kupa pette erne wolam.
Wolam, Pailat ere kir tem, eke ere yin Jisas eri kupa neneyeirin peten sen yin mate geipak leyen sele meike rasem. Ete sele mei eme pape purik nenem, kiyi eme tame kupa wuri etek beke ras.
Erne rasem yabel e Pasova a nenbetem yabel. Ege si yabel tete nenbetem.
Galilike yam ta, kiyi Jisas eterken yam ta eme Joseph eterken yin sele mei lam. Jisas eri kupa rasem emi eme lam.
Lam, eme emri akek sene yin kwarken bos yenbo yabe wosken eme Jisas eteri kupa kerete eyarem. Eyarem, ege si yabel eme God eteri wule abom, eme etep bepou me sim, eme yaku beke kere.
